units.source_text: [\[30\]](#part1331.html#w30) 传说信州伊那郡园原伏屋地方，有一怪树，名曰帚木。

en.t: According to legend, in the Sonohara Fuseya area of Ina District in Shinshu, there is a strange tree called the Broom Tree.

units.source_text: 此树远看形似倒置的扫帚，走近去就看不见了。

en.t: Seen from far away, this tree looks like an upside-down broom, but when one comes closer, it can no longer be seen.
In this poem, the Broom Tree is used as a comparison for Utsusemi.
